description: WHEN TO USE: Simulates moving volatile mid-prompt tokens after the static prefix to eliminate cold cache-write invalidation and restore warm cache read rates on a catalog model. DO NOT USE: For 10-turn forward session cache ROI projections (use pin_single_model_prefix_cache). INPUTS & DEFAULTS: model defaults to 'openai/gpt-6.1-sol', static_prefix_tokens defaults to 52695 (>= 0), dynamic_mid_tokens defaults to 93029 (>= 0), completion_tokens defaults to 2696 (>= 0); zero tokens return $0 cleanly. BEHAVIOR: Stateless read-only layout simulation; mutates no prompts or live state. OUTPUT: JSON with before_layout_cost_usd, after_layout_cost_usd, net_saved_per_call_usd, net_savings_pct, and recommended_message_order.

completion_tokens.description: Output completion token count for the turn.

dynamic_mid_tokens.description: Token count of volatile per-turn context that invalidates downstream cache breakpoints.

model.description: Target provider/model ID used to price cold write vs warm read layout costs (e.g. 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5' or 'openai/gpt-6.1-sol').

static_prefix_tokens.description: Token count of invariant system instructions and repository context.

name: optimize_prompt_cache_layout
